news.title: Democrats win control of both House and Senate in U.S. midterms
news.summary: Democrats flipped seven Senate seats, including Texas, Ohio, Maine and Kansas, and the AP called the House for them early Wednesday. Trump congratulated Democrats but said the result was not a verdict on him and threatened to veto their bills.

news.title: U.S. launches limited strikes on Iranian targets in Strait of Hormuz
news.summary: Explosions were reported on Qeshm and Hengam islands and near Bandar Abbas hours before the midterms; a U.S. official said the targets had fired missiles at U.S. forces. Iran says the strait stays shut unless the U.S. lifts its oil blockade.

news.title: Russian strike on Ukrainian aid centre kills 33, dozens trapped
news.summary: A strike on a former school used for aid handouts in Komyshuvakha, southeastern Ukraine, killed 33 people, Zelenskyy said, with more than 50 possibly still under rubble. A separate strike hit a hospital in Kharkiv.

news.title: Nasdaq rises 0.8% as AI stocks rebound; futures jump after midterms
news.summary: On Tuesday the S&P 500 rose 0.36% to 7,568.92 and the Nasdaq gained 0.83% to 25,372.01, while the Dow fell 0.38% to 51,787.04. U.S. futures dipped after the Democratic sweep, then rose more than 1% before Wednesday's open.

news.title: AMD jumps 8% after hours on record quarter and $17B outlook
news.summary: AMD posted Q3 revenue of $13.38 billion, up 45%, and adjusted EPS of $2.09, both above estimates. Data centre sales nearly doubled and now make up 64% of revenue; it guided Q4 to about $17 billion.

news.title: Israel finds no fraud in election as Netanyahu bloc loses majority
news.summary: The election commission found no irregularities in last week's vote, in which neither Netanyahu's bloc nor Gadi Eisenkot's won a majority. Arab-led parties now hold the balance of power, and President Herzog will start consultations.

news.title: Carney says Russian athletes barred from World Juniors in Alberta
news.summary: Carney said Russian and Belarusian athletes won't be let into Canada while the war in Ukraine goes on, despite a sports court ruling that the IIHF must reinstate Russia. The tournament starts Dec. 26 in Edmonton and Red Deer.

news.title: Trump says U.S. will end $4B annual aid to Israel, sell arms instead
news.summary: Trump told Fox News the roughly $4 billion in yearly military aid will end starting in 2027 and be replaced by arms sales. He said Netanyahu had raised the idea.

news.title: Midterms bring historic firsts in governors' races and the Senate
news.summary: Keisha Lance Bottoms became the first Black woman elected governor of a U.S. state, in Georgia, and Deb Haaland the first Native American woman governor, in New Mexico. Chris Pappas will be the first openly gay man in the Senate.

news.title: Ohio voters back AI data centre bans in at least 14 towns
news.summary: Ohio had 21 of the 41 local data centre measures on ballots nationwide, and voters passed bans or limits in at least 14 municipalities, some by about 80%. Sherrod Brown, who opposed data centre tax breaks, won the Senate race.

news.title: Federal budget to include immigration levels update, sources say
news.summary: Thursday's budget will update Canada's immigration plan; the current target is 380,000 permanent residents a year. Non-permanent residents are 6.7% of the population, against a 5% goal.

news.title: Eurozone inflation climbs to 4%, a three-year high
news.summary: October flash inflation rose to 4.0% from 3.8%, driven by energy prices up 20.8% year on year; core inflation held at 2.5%. Markets now see a high chance of an ECB rate hike in December.

news.title: Anthropic unveils FlashProve to verify which AI model produced an output
news.summary: The open-source system uses cryptographic 'provable inference' and published model fingerprints to show which model generated a response, without exposing weights. Anthropic calls it early research with no plans to deploy yet.

news.title: Ottawa backs De Havilland with up to $2.5B to build more water bombers
news.summary: Export Development Canada loans and guarantees will fund a second assembly line in Alberta, with the aim of reaching 20 planes a year. The company has 38 orders, but its first DHC-515 isn't expected until early 2028.

news.title: Apple starts testing Apple Intelligence in China with Alibaba's Qwen
news.summary: A developer trial of 18 features, such as live call translation, began Wednesday, and public access is planned for December. More than 110 million iPhones in China can run the features.

news.title: AI inference startup Fal doubles valuation to $16B
news.summary: Fal raised $1.3 billion in a round led by Bessemer, with Nvidia also taking part. That doubles its valuation from April, amid strong demand for hosted AI video, image and audio models.

news.title: Ontario to approve AI data centres 'sooner rather than later'
news.summary: Minister Vic Fedeli says the first projects will be approved soon, despite one-year moratoriums in Oakville, Mississauga and Sault Ste. Marie. The Greens plan a bill for a province-wide pause.

news.title: Switching to potassium salt could prevent ~3M deaths a year, study finds
news.summary: A George Institute study of 193 countries estimates a worldwide switch to potassium-enriched salt could prevent about 2.96 million deaths and 10 million heart and kidney disease cases each year.
